content: अभिमानः .²1 Pride (in a good sense), self-respect, honourable or worthy feeling; सदाभिमानैकधना हि मानिनः <ls>Śi. 1. 67</ls>; त्यक्त्वा जातिकुलाभिमानमुचितम् <ls>Bh. 3. 5</ls>. अभिमानधनस्य गत्वरैः <ls>Ki. 2. 19</ls>; संकल्पयोनेरभिमानभूतम् <ls>Ku. 3. 24</ls>. .²2 Self-conceit, pride, arrogance, haughtiness, egotism, high opinion of oneself; शिथिल˚ नाः संवृत्ताः <ls>M. 2</ls>; <ls>Bh. 3. 46</ls>; <ls>Bg. 16. 4</ls>; (अतिमानः is another reading) ˚वत् proud, conceited. .²3 Referring all objects to self, the act of अहंकार, personality, misconception (मिथ्याज्ञानम्), see अहंकार. .²4 Conceit, conception; supposition, belief, opinion; मुनिरस्मि निरागसः कुतो मे भयमित्येष न भूतयेऽभिमानः <ls>Ki. 13. 7</ls>. .²5 Knowledge, consciousness (बुद्धि, ज्ञान); साधारण्याभिमानतः <ls>S. D.</ls> .²6 Affection, love. .²7 Desire, wishing for. .²8 Laying claim to. .²9 Injury, Killing, seeking to injure. .²10 A sort of state occasioned by love. .{@-नम्@} Authority (प्रमाण); ये चरन्त्यभिमानानि सृष्टार्थमनुषङ्गिणः <ls>Mb. 12. 168. 23</ls>.
